from datetime import datetime,timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from app.models import Branch,WaitlistEntry,WaitlistStatus,WaitlistSource
db=SessionLocal()
bid=db.query(Branch).first().id
day=(datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei'))-timedelta(hours=4)).date().isoformat()
for i in range(200):
    db.add(WaitlistEntry(branch_id=bid,queue_number='F%03d'%i,full_queue_number='F-%s-%03d'%(day.replace('-',''),i),queue_prefix='F',seq=100+i,business_date=day,name='Fix%03d'%i,phone='0911-000-%03d'%(100+i),party_size=2,status=WaitlistStatus.WAITING,sort_order=100+i,source=WaitlistSource.CUSTOMER))

from sqlalchemy import event
stmts=[]
@event.listens_for(engine,'after_cursor_execute')
def cap(conn,cursor,stmt,params,context,executemany):
    stmts.append((stmt,tuple(params) if params else ()))

up=[(s.upper(),p) for s,p in stmts]

lim=[(s,p) for s,p in up if 'WAITLIST_ENTRIES' in s and 'LIMIT' in s and 'OFFSET' in s and 10 in p and 20 in p]
